steps.title: Build a small seed box
steps.body: Create a compact box that is easy to duplicate many times without cluttering the scene.

success.prompt: A small seed box exists and is selected or easy to reselect.

steps.title: Run a linear copy
steps.body: Use Copy Multiple to measure one direction and fill it with repeated copies.
steps.notes: This is the straight-line array tool and is the closest match to a classic linear array command.

success.prompt: You can see a row of repeated boxes.

steps.title: Check spacing and count
steps.body: Orbit slightly and confirm that the copies read as a measured row rather than stacked duplicates on top of each other.

actions.description: Use an orbit overview if available.

steps.title: Expand to a planar grid
steps.body: Switch to Planar Translate Multiple and define the second translation direction so the row becomes a 2D field.

actions.description: Activate the planar translation array tool.

success.prompt: The repeated boxes now occupy a grid on a plane.

steps.title: Fill a volume
steps.body: Switch to Volumetric Translate Multiple and define a third extent so the copies occupy a box-like volume.
steps.notes: This is useful when testing shelving, pallets, block-outs, or voxel-like massing.

actions.description: Activate the volumetric translation array tool.

success.prompt: The seed box has been repeated into a 3D block of copies.
